Looking to schedule routine care for yourself or your family? At Harbour Dental, our standard check-up and cleaning is $145.

Our team is licensed by the Oregon Board of Dentistry, providing thorough preventative dental care in Southeast Portland.

We are open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm and Friday from 8am to 2pm.

Free parking is available behind the building for your appointment.

posts.caption: Harbour Dental provides general and cosmetic dental care in Southeast Portland. Our office is licensed by the Oregon Board of Dentistry and located at 2215 SE Harbour Avenue, Suite 105, Portland, OR 97214. Free parking is available behind the building. Operating hours are Monday to Thursday 8am to 5pm, and Friday 8am to 2pm.
